question: Tai sao cac cong ty tuyen AI Engineer ve lai cam thay khong hieu qua?
selectedText: Tuyen dung AI Engineer o at nam 2024. Cac cong ty tuyen AI Engineer nhung van khong hieu qua vi thieu nguoi dat de bai dung.
answer: Theo doan tai lieu, cong ty tuyen AI Engineer van khong hieu qua vi thieu nguoi biet dat de bai dung. Engineer chi giai bai toan da ro, con san pham can nguoi xac dinh dung van de truoc.

question: Dac diem cua tu duy nhanh la gi?
selectedText: Tu duy he thong 1 la tu duy nhanh, tu dong, theo thoi quen. Tu duy he thong 2 la cham hon va can no luc.
answer: System 1 la tu duy nhanh: tu dong, theo thoi quen va it ton no luc. System 2 la tu duy cham: can tap trung, can no luc va dung de kiem tra lai quyet dinh.

question: Tai sao lai goi ky thuat nay la Dropout? No ngat cai gi?
selectedText: Ky thuat Dropout tat ngau nhien mot ty le neuron trong qua trinh huan luyen de giam overfitting.
answer: Dropout la ky thuat tat ngau nhien mot ty le neuron trong qua trinh huan luyen. Cach nay giup mo hinh khong phu thuoc qua muc vao mot so neuron va giam overfitting.

question: Khi chay predict thuc te thi cac neuron co bi tat ngau nhien nua khong?
selectedText: Dropout luc inference khong tat ngau nhien neuron nua; tat ca neuron deu duoc bat.
answer: Khong. Khi predict/test/inference thi Dropout khong tat neuron ngau nhien nua; tat ca neuron deu duoc bat de mo hinh chay on dinh.

question: Su khac biet lon nhat giua Automation va Augmentation la gi?
selectedText: Automation la tu dong hoa hoan toan. Augmentation la tang cuong cong viec va van co con nguoi kiem soat.
answer: Khong phai la mot, hai khai niem nay khac nhau. Automation la may tu dong lam gan nhu hoan toan; Augmentation la AI ho tro/tang cuong cong viec nhung van co con nguoi kiem soat.

question: Agent khac gi voi cach lam Rule-based thong thuong?
selectedText: Ba cap do AI gom Rule-based, Workflow va Agent. Rule-based dung quy tac if-else tinh, Agent duoc giao quyen tu suy nghi va chia task.
answer: Rule-based dung cac quy tac if-else tinh do con nguoi dat san. Agent khac o cho no duoc giao quyen tu suy nghi, tu chia task va quyet dinh buoc tiep theo linh hoat hon.

question: Em muon hoc lam AI Engineer thi co can hoc them ky nang dat de bai hay phan bo cong viec khong?
selectedText: Tuyen dung AI Engineer khong du neu cong ty thieu nguoi dat de bai, phan bo cong viec va xac dinh dung van de san pham.
answer: Nen hoc them tu duy product, ky nang dat de bai va phan bo cong viec. Doan tai lieu noi van de khong nam o viec thieu engineer, ma o viec thieu nguoi xac dinh dung bai toan cho engineer giai.

question: Ren luyen tu duy cham rat met, neu em chi muon xai tu duy nhanh cho do ton no-ron thi co nguy co gi khong?
selectedText: Tu duy nhanh la tu dong, theo thoi quen; tu duy cham can no luc hon de tranh sai lam.
answer: Co nguy co. Neu chi dung tu duy nhanh, ban de quyet dinh theo thoi quen va de mac sai lam; tu duy cham giup kiem tra lai khi van de can suy nghi can than.

question: Neu em dat ty le p = 0 thi ky thuat Dropout nay co con tac dung gi khong?
selectedText: Dropout tat ngau nhien mot ty le p neuron khi train.
answer: Khong co tac dung dropout neu p = 0, vi khi do khong co neuron nao bi tat trong qua trinh huan luyen.

question: Tai sao luc inference lai phai nhan voi 1-p? Nghe khong hop ly lam, nhan vao de lam gi?
selectedText: Dropout luc inference bat tat ca neuron va nhan voi 1-p de can bang tong nang luong tinh toan.
answer: Nhan voi 1-p luc inference de can bang lai tong nang luong/gia tri tinh toan khi tat ca neuron deu duoc bat, tranh lam dau ra bi lech so voi luc train.

question: Co phai cu dung Augmentation cho tat ca moi thu la an toan tuyet doi khong?
selectedText: Automation va augmentation can duoc chon theo rui ro. Augmentation co con nguoi giam sat nen an toan hon trong viec rui ro cao.
answer: Khong co cach nao an toan tuyet doi. Augmentation an toan hon trong bai toan rui ro cao vi co con nguoi giam sat, nhung van can kiem tra va thiet ke quy trinh phu hop.
